dogecoin.text: @Ironlynx87 @dogecoin_empire Fair enough clear communication makes things so much easier. If someone offers and insists, there’s no harm in letting them treat you. It’s about mutual respect, not assumptions

@Ironlynx87 @dogecoin_empire That said, many of us were raised in a way that still values a man insisting on treating, especially on a first date. At the end of the day, it’s less about strict protocol and more about mutual respect and appreciation for each other’s effort.

@Ironlynx87 @dogecoin_empire That’s really generous of you, and I know a lot of women appreciate that gesture. Personally, I think whoever does the inviting should at least offer to pay it shows thoughtfulness and respect.
